note: The musics a video can play in the background. `start`: where a video starts a track (seconds): on a clear attack from which it is loud at once and stays so; `bpm`: its tempo there, to the hundredth (an intro played on it lasts four of its beats); `lufs`: its loudness as recorded. All measured on the files the app plays (scripts/make-musics.py --beats, --measure). `kinds`, `genre` and `about` (what the AI reads to choose one) come from a model that listened to each track (scripts/make-musics.py --listen, 15/11/2026).
